senses.gloss:
mn. (-उः-उ)
A sieve, a cribble.
E.
तन to spread or scatter, (grain, &c.) डौ Uṇādi affix, and the radical reiterated.

f. (-क्षा)
Patience, resignation, sufferance, endurance.
E.
तिज to bear, अङ् and टाप् affix, and the root repeated.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Patient, resigned.
E.
तिज to bear, affix इतच्, and the root reduplicate.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Patient, resigned.
E.
तिज to bear, reduplicated, and उ aff.

n. (-लं)
1 One of the seven Karaṇas, or astronomical periods so called.
2 A bowl or bucket.
3 A sort of sweetmeat made of sesamum, ground, and baked with sugar.
E.
तिल to go, affix क, and the radical reiterated: see तैतिल.

f. (-र्षा)
1 Wish to cross.
2 Wish to be freed from life.
E.
तॄ to cross, desid, form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु)
1 Desirous of crossing.
2 Desirous of emancipation from existence.
E.
तॄ to cross, desid. form, affix उ.

m. (रः)
The francoline partridge: see the next.

m. (-रिः)
1 The francoline partridge.
2 The name of a Muni, and one of the early teachers of the Taittiri or Black Yajur Veda.
3 The Yajur Veda, named after its teacher.
E.
तित्ति an imitative sound, रा to make, affix कि; also with क affix तित्तिर.
